stories.title: MLB Rank 2026 in-season update: Ranking baseball's top 50 players
stories.summary: We asked ESPN MLB experts for their updated top 50 to take stock of the best performances as the 2026 regular season begins to wind down.

stories.title: Daniels miffed over LSU giving Pickett his No. 5
stories.summary: Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels informed LSU that it can no longer use his name, image and likeness and said he felt "profoundly disrespected" after the school allowed cornerback DJ Pickett to wear his former No. 5 jersey.

stories.title: Freeman 'in good spirits' after fall into dugout
stories.summary: Dodgers first baseman Freddie Freeman apparently avoided serious injury when he took a frightening tumble down the stairs and into the visitors dugout while trying to catch a foul popup.

stories.title: McCarthy: Vikings' QB decision 'out of my control'
stories.summary: The decision to name Kyler Murray the winner of the Vikings' quarterback competition this week was "out of my control," former starter J.J. McCarthy said Wednesday.

stories.title: Westbrook retires from NBA after 18 seasons
stories.summary: Russell Westbrook, who played 18 NBA seasons with seven teams, announced his retirement Wednesday.
